WITH payments_per_order AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    SUM(payment_value) AS order_total
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
items_per_order AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    COUNT(order_item_id) AS items_count
  FROM order_items
  GROUP BY order_id
),
reviews_per_order AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    AVG(review_score) AS review_score
  FROM order_reviews
  GROUP BY order_id
),
orders_enriched AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id,
    o.order_id,
    o.order_purchase_timestamp,
    p.order_total,
    i.items_count,
    r.review_score
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN payments_per_order p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
  LEFT JOIN items_per_order i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  LEFT JOIN reviews_per_order r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    customer_unique_id,
    COUNT(order_id) AS total_orders,
    SUM(COALESCE(order_total, 0.0)) AS total_revenue,
    AVG(order_total) AS average_order_value,
    AVG(review_score) AS average_review_score,
    AVG(items_count) AS average_items_per_order,
    MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_order_date,
    MAX(order_purchase_timestamp) AS last_order_date
  FROM orders_enriched
  GROUP BY customer_unique_id
)
SELECT
  customer_unique_id,
  total_orders,
  total_revenue,
  average_order_value,
  average_review_score,
  average_items_per_order,
  first_order_date,
  last_order_date
FROM customer_metrics
ORDER BY total_orders DESC
LIMIT 3;
